status: data and lifecycle contract frozen; production admission remains unavailable
scope: only complete Supervisor ConfigureProjectScope intent; no general RPC, Ticket or model command

framing.direction: parent-owned stdio proposed; no production startup flag or pipe loop implemented
framing.stdout: recognized frames must be suppressed from application logs; stderr never interpreted as control
framing.failure: invalid prefix, UTF-8, size, JSON/schema or partial EOF closes channel; no automatic replay

validation.uuids: non-nil UUIDs; launch generated by child anew per launch; identifiers are not credentials
validation.revision: exact u64; JS rejects non-safe values rather than rounds; never Work binding_revision
validation.project_ids: existing typed Domain ProjectId; <=64 complete entries, duplicate entries rejected; empty explicit set valid
validation.active_projects_and_cas: remain original canonical use-case responsibilities; decoding does not grant or apply

lifecycle.handshake: one exact-launch ack establishes transport only, never owner authorization
lifecycle.admission: there is no verified native admission source in existing products; UnadmittedChannel has no method to install one from a frame
lifecycle.consent: independently verified Host authority must bind complete immutable intent, launch_id and request_id; Rust callback is pure, not itself admission
lifecycle.replay: all structurally valid request IDs are spent before consent check or future CAS; no eviction; repeats409 native_request_replay; capacity503 native_channel_exhausted
lifecycle.cancel_before_submit: native sends no apply; no mutation. No wire cancellation after an apply may claim rollback.
lifecycle.apply_started: one captured non-cloneable local permit; no replacement intent
lifecycle.reply: after canonical result, retain in-flight state until reply actually flushed
lifecycle.disconnect: in-flight or reply-pending ->sticky outcome unconfirmed; canonical read only, no retransmit. Idle is not proof about historical writes.
lifecycle.restart: new launch; all old launch frames and old per-launch consent rejected; no persisted proof or request-ID registry

authority_product_choice.frozen_current: No pipe/PID/bundle-name/ad-hoc-signature admission; production capability remains unavailable.
authority_product_choice.minimum_positive_requirement: A proof of explicit owner consent independently verified by Bamboo, not a parent assertion. Prefer Bamboo-owned per-operation native OS user-presence/confirmation over creating persistent Host credentials.
not_yet_authorized_or_implemented: new security configuration or persistent access credential
platform user-presence implementation and actual interactive verification
authority_product_choice.installed_bodhi_evidence: read-only codesign: adhoc, no TeamIdentifier; not a usable publisher trust anchor
authority_product_choice.boundary: pure protocol/default-deny/mock work proceeds; production apply/startup installation stops at this authority-source decision

bamboo: future minimal serve adapter only after genuine authority source is agreed; ordinary CLI/WebService remain None
bodhi: owned-child lifecycle and strict counterpart codec
no JS proof or direct PUT; remain unavailable without verified authority
frontend: read-only scope decoder and complete-set review

acceptance.implemented_pure_component: not production startup wiring; no AppState, CAS or HTTP path used
acceptance.initial_state_unit: 10P on first prototype; framing/codec additions await their own execution
acceptance.required: strict decode/default-deny and lifecycle unit checks, then current-source integration after authority source decision and explicit serial Rust handoff

bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.change: additive Bamboo-owned per-intent native confirmation profile; framing and full intent unchanged

authority_profile.confirmation_available: boolean; readiness to ask Bamboo once, never existing consent
authority_profile.unavailable_code: null when available, otherwise one stable refusal code

hello_ready.authority_profile: required for this new profile, absence means legacy unavailable
hello_ready.transport_ready: still transport only; both ready and exact profile required

bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.apply: same existing full intent frame; asks Bamboo itself to display and verify this exact request; no caller proof/confirmed/secret/new credential

cancelled.guarantee: Bamboo never submitted this request to management CAS; no receipt and no automatic retry

refused.guarantee: no management CAS submitted; readiness can change between inspect and request

outcomes.committed: existing canonical receipt only after fresh canonical validation and exact CAS
outcomes.outcome_unconfirmed: existing schema for issued CAS/storage ambiguity or lost in-flight response; never relabel as cancelled/committed from matching GET

binding: unique request_id spent before any prompt
same bound confirmation request through the provider and CAS

lifecycle.native_cancel: only Cancel/close/timeout before submission; consume request ID
lifecycle.disconnect_before_cas: Bamboo cancels native helper and forbids submission; client without cancellation response remains conservatively unknown
lifecycle.disconnect_after_cas_or_reply_pending: unconfirmed; refresh canonical state, never replay
lifecycle.conflict_after_confirmation: fresh identity, Project status and expected management revision checks; 409 scope_revision_conflict, no new automatic prompt/retry
lifecycle.restart: new launch, no restored consent or request replay

bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.http: existing HTTP owner_authorization.available=false remains truthful: no HTTP owner verifier installed. New native adapter readiness is independent and must not be inferred from or blocked only by that HTTP boolean.
bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.production_native: macOS Bamboo-owned same-executable UI helper on initial main thread, NSAlert + read-only scrolling complete intent/before-after preview; Cancel is default. Other platforms default-deny until implemented. No auto click or persistent approval.
bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.limits: existing 16KiB request framing /64 spent IDs per launch retained; full preview is bounded and never truncated; preview failure default-denies
bamboo_native_confirmation_v1.validation: mock consent is cfg(test) only; positive actual UI approval must be by user after Root presents isolated one-time full preview
